correctness.rationale: For uniform pairings of N even labeled half-edges, L=Σ of S=ΣC(d_i,2) loop indicators and P=Σ of B=2Σ a_i a_j double-edge pair indicators. Fixed indicators have expectations 1/(N-1) and 1/((N-1)(N-3)). Per parallel-pair event, exactly 2(d_i+d_j-3) loop events overlap its four stubs, giving total incompatibilities T=4Σa_i a_j(d_i+d_j-3). Compatible six-stub indicator pairs yield E(LP)=(SB-T)/[(N-1)(N-3)(N-5)]. Subtracting means yields [4SB-(N-1)T]/[(N-1)^2(N-3)(N-5)]. Regular substitution gives sign factor vd(2-d)+2d-3, positive for d=2,v>=3 and negative for d>=3,v>=2, and asymptotic +1/(8v²) vs -(d-1)^2(d-2)/(2dv). The N=4 exceptional (v,d)=(2,2) gives -4/9 separately. Independently enumerated all 15 pairings for (2,2,2) and (3,3) and 105 for (2,2,2,2), obtaining respectively 4/25, -36/25, 8/245.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks are corroborative; unrestricted theorem rests on mathematical reductions and exact certificates, not samples.
